data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Products menu, then a product, then the compare link, then an optional Upgrade) with product as a parameter. It adds a "tier" parameter and says click instead of hover for the menu, and it doesn't name the final_action parameter. Even so, an automation could be built from it with only minor tweaks.
